pages.text: Pongi's little brother was crying in the middle of the room. The shell that had been in those little paws was nowhere to be seen.
"I'll find it for you." Pongi clenched both front paws.
Pongi looked under a cushion. Only dust puffed out.
Dad opened the shoe cabinet. "I think it might be in here."
All that came out of the shoe cabinet was one dry leaf.
This time Dad lifted the lid of a pot. There were potatoes inside.
"Dad, why would the shell be in a pot?"
Pongi's little brother suddenly stopped crying and held out both paws.
There was the shell, in a little palm. It had been held so tightly that nobody could see it.
Dad was still looking into the pot. "I really think it might be in here." Pongi looked at her little brother, who gripped the shell tightly again.
